report_title: DETAILED PROJECT REPORT - ANIMAL FEED MAKING UNIT

narrative.product_intro: Compound animal (cattle) feed is a balanced blend of grains, brans, protein meals/cakes, chunnies, agro-industrial by-products and mineral-vitamin mixtures, pelleted for easy feeding; quality compound feed supplies the macro and micronutrients dairy animals cannot get from crop-residue-based diets.
narrative.raw_material_note: Raw materials: grains (maize, wheat, millets), brans (rice polish, de-oiled rice bran, wheat bran), protein meals/cakes (soybean, groundnut, cottonseed), pulse chunnies, molasses and mineral/vitamin premix - all traded agro commodities available in local markets.
process_steps: Procurement and testing of raw materials (toxicity and quality)
Batch mixing of ingredients as per feed formulation
Grinding of mixed material to 1-2 mm particle size
Mixing of minerals, vitamins and additives in ribbon mixer
Steam conditioning of feed at 70-80 deg C
Filling and packaging in HDPE/gunny bags
